title: Bartimaeus
description: The blind beggar Bartimaeus, the son of Timaeus, sits by the road outside Jericho. When he hears that Jesus is passing by, he cries out: "Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!" He does not let the crowd stop him from shouting at him; instead, he throws off his cloak and comes to Jesus. At Jesus' question about what he wants, he asks to regain his sight, and Jesus heals him because of his faith. Bartimaeus then follows Jesus on the way.
